description: Experimental structured extraction from one to six nonconfidential product records supplied as text. No URL fetching or OCR. Check catalog_extraction.available first. One task unit, bounded retries; retain idempotency_key. Output includes JSON/CSV with source quotes and null for missing data. Schema and source matching are checked, semantic correctness is not guaranteed. Poll get_studio_job.
